item.text: {"summary":"The decoder rejects valid unpadded inputs: its remainder check requires exactly the expected number of padding characters, despite the implementation comment and public contract saying padding is optional. This accounts for failures in both Base64 alphabets and the one- and two-byte input cases.","hypotheses":["Base64UnescapeInternal accepts only the padded remainder count when decoded input leaves one or two bytes, rejecting zero padding."],"queries":[],"reads":[],"ready":true}
